query: Do European approvals of ofatumumab for MS exclude any lymphocyte-count subgroups, and how is that stated versus broader carrier-style language?

pubmed.title: EU SmPC: ofatumumab contraindicated when lymphocytes <0.5×10^9/L
pubmed.summary: European marketing authorisation contraindicates ofatumumab when absolute lymphocyte count is below 0.5×10^9/L. Patients above that threshold remain eligible with monitoring.

europe_pmc.title: US vs EU ofatumumab labelling on lymphocyte thresholds
europe_pmc.summary: EU labelling uses a numeric lymphocyte threshold (<0.5×10^9/L). Broader phrases such as 'patients with lymphopenia' overstate the excluded population.

dailymed.title: Ofatumumab US label — laboratory monitoring
dailymed.summary: US labelling requires baseline and ongoing lymphocyte monitoring for ofatumumab without copying the EU numeric contraindication wording verbatim.
